quest:Egggulyte1.name: Egg_Shaped_Lootboxes!
quest:Egggulyte1.description: Defeat monsters and find some egg capsules! Open them for rewards!

quest:Egggulyte2.name: I've_Got_a_Golden_Tickegg!
quest:Egggulyte2.description: Open Egg Capsules until you find a Golden Egg! Previously found ones don't count!

item:Quest42.name: Egg_Capsule
item:Quest42.description: Hold down to open for a random reward! Or, hold down for a LONG time to open them faster... yea, dreams do come true

item:Quest43.name: Gummy_Bunny
item:Quest43.description: Hold down to summon a friendly easter monster. But be careful, unlike real life where all friends are genuine, these monsters are just pretending to be your friend for personal gain!

item:PremiumGem.name: Gem
item:PremiumGem.description: Hold down to add these gems to your account. You can then spend them in the Gem Shop!
